description: This file is a shell script defining functions related to diff comparison and normalization, including functions for sanitizing and comparing diff outputs.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitizing specific patterns to ignore score numbers and other heuristics.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Similar to compare_diff_raw but also translates null characters before comparison.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff patches after removing non-essential lines such as index and similarity index lines.
